title: Pilot iteration 2: K=64-scenario action-complete H40 corpus with fresh held-out origins
hypothesis: Raising aligned chance scenarios from K=8 to K=64 (the only change from EX-20260820-afterstate-pilot-h40-29b8588a) lifts scenario-half label stability above the frozen 0.5 Spearman floor, and the unchanged distributional afterstate ranker then ranks fresh held-out whole-origin siblings non-inferiorly to exact fair D4 on top-1 accuracy, pairwise accuracy, and normalized regret against the scenario-mean H40 outcome ranking.

data.reuseDisclosure: Training corpus: seeds 0x5da70000-0x5da700ff (the same 256 origins as iteration 1, including its former held-out roots, which are now training-only and are never evaluated again). Evaluation corpus: fresh seeds 0x5da70100-0x5da7013f (64 origins), all held-out, read for the first time by this experiment's single gate evaluation. Iteration 1's gate outcome was inconclusive on label stability; this experiment changes only the scenario count and the held-out origins. No protected or final data is read.

metrics.primary: Fresh held-out whole-origin top-1 action accuracy of the model's scenario-averaged ranking against the scenario-mean H40 outcome ranking, compared with exact fair D4's top-1 accuracy on the same roots.
secondary: within-root pairwise accuracy and normalized regret versus the same target, model and fair D4 and fair D1
quantile calibration (nominal 76.5% outer-interval coverage) on held-out afterstates
label stability: per-root Spearman correlation of action rankings between independent scenario halves (32 vs 32)
action completeness (fraction of legal siblings with labels; must be 1.0)
logical work and wall time per corpus root; training wall time and peak shared memory
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: Two deterministic held-out half-folds by origin-game hash (mix32 of the origin seed); a metric counts only if it moves the same direction in both halves. No complete-game confidence intervals are produced at this tier.

passCriteria: Corpus is successor-closed: every non-trivial harvested root (>=2 legal actions) has labels for every legal sibling under all 64 scenarios.

Label stability floor: mean per-root Spearman correlation between scenario-half (32 vs 32) action rankings >= 0.5 on held-out roots; below this the outcome is inconclusive (labels too noisy), not a pass or a theory rejection.
Model top-1 accuracy >= fair D4 top-1 accuracy - 0.02 on each held-out half-fold.
Model pairwise accuracy >= fair D4 pairwise accuracy - 0.02 on each held-out half-fold.
Model normalized regret <= fair D4 normalized regret + 0.02 on each held-out half-fold.
Nominal 76.5% quantile interval coverage on held-out afterstates within [0.66, 0.87].
All CHECK-tier mechanics, legality, determinism, reflection, information-boundary, and resource-bound tests pass before any label is inspected.
gate.failureAction: Record a valid negative (or inconclusive, if the stability floor fails again) result for this exact configuration. If stability passes but the model trails D4, the theory is not supported as tested; keep both corpus manifests for diagnosis and open no gameplay tier.
gate.passAction: Register a successor SCREEN experiment: 32 paired public-development games of the frozen 1-ply chance-averaged afterstate policy with exact fair-D4 fallback versus unchanged fair D4. The candidate, corpus, and thresholds are not retuned on the held-out fold first.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.
Stop corpus generation after 2 hours wall or 320 harvest games, whichever comes first.
Stop fair-D4 comparator labeling after 3 hours wall.
Stop training after 2 hours GPU wall or 20 epochs, whichever comes first.
Stop immediately on out-of-memory or on host available memory falling below 16 GiB.
Stop on any read of a seed outside the named lease.

runs/<run-id>/corpus-b/*.ndjson K=64 fresh held-out corpus with content manifest
runs/<run-id>/d4-labels-b/*.tsv comparator rankings for held-out roots

runs/<run-id>/gate/gate-report.json with all primary and secondary metrics
